harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.description: On borg-reborn-rs main e0aa2e0a with healing speed 66, which healing curve scale (50, 100, 200 percent) and healing reserve (0, 200, 400 percent of max HP) should the town planner use? Generated from definitions/reborn-heal-curve-pilot.yaml: 9 arms on 4.2.6-reborn-rust-main-e0aa2e0a, suite classes-18.
experiment.name: reborn-heal-curve-pilot
experiment.owner_authorization: 2026-11-17: after the #192 small tier (run 44116104222) and the reserve x speed pilot (run 44119472667), the owner noted the healing curve scale had never been varied and asked to propose reserve {0, 200, 400} x curve {50, 100, 200} at speed 66, on the small tier's specimen so its arms can be compared. The owner then asked for the pilot first (RULES 14); the small tier follows only after this gate and the owner.
experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-17, before any result was read (borg-zoo#192). Pilot, as the owner asked (the request was
for small); small only after this gate and the owner (RULES 14). The curve scale stretches the town planner's diminishing healing curve: weight and
demand scale together, so the first HP keeps its value and the half-value point moves to the scale's
percent of today's (50 = stops buying healing sooner, 200 = keeps buying). Gate: no config_error; one
binary; the three borg_param_town_heal_* lines with the arm's values (reserve 0/200/400, curve
50/100/200, speed 66) in every arm's borg.txt and in params-core.json of the death replays; no plan
loaded; every cell ends in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped; frozen-turn stalls and key outliers listed;
death bundles reproduced. Consistency check (pilot): the requested comparison with reborn-heal-reserve-s66-small
needs the same starts, and that run played classes-1800, not classes-18, so it applies to the small
tier, not here. Checked locally before dispatch instead: two r400-c100 games on that run's starts
reproduce its CI key hashes on this specimen. Report per arm: deaths, final level,
deepest level, keys; deaths by class, with low-max-HP casters (Mage, Necromancer) called out; paired
rescued and newly killed against r0-c100 on the same start, with an exact McNemar p; per reserve, the
same against its own c100 arm; healing potions bought (Cure Light/Serious/Critical Wounds, Healing),
Phase Door bought, and gold on each against all gold spent, from all games where the run records
purchases, else from the death replays (say which). Watch the Phase Door crowding a local simulation
found (borg-reborn-rs, 18 starts: departures with no Phase Door 38 at r0 against 114 at r400-c100,
concentrated in Warrior 1019921749 and Ranger 1739161339): does c50 reduce it? r400-c100 is the shipped
value. 18 starts per arm show direction only.
